How i prepared for Leadership Questions (Behaviourval Questions) asked for Amazon.
During Amazon interview , you will come across question on Leadership Principles in each round and this is really important to get into Amazon.
So don't neglect this if you get chance to interview with Amazon.
HR had told me to answer all Leadership Questions (Behaviourval) using ‘STAR’ pattern.
S(Situation): Describe the SITUATION you were in.
T(task): Explain the TASK that needed to be done.
A(Action): Detail the ACTION that you took to achieve the task.
R(Result): Reveal the RESULTS of your action.
How to answer in better way:
1) Give all answer using STAR pattern.
2) Give answer relating to your work experience / projects using technical terms to get good impression rather than giving general answer.
Note: I gave very generalised answer in 1st round and feedback was mixed for behavioural question.
What all questions i have prepared?
-> I just researched for few hours and went through a more than 20+ recent interview experiences on Leetcode and noted all unique Leadership questions(behavioural) at once place.
-> Prepared for each question using STAR pattern relating to my experience with different different technical terms.
-> For 1-2 questions that i was not able to relate to my experiences in better way, i took help of chatgpt to frame a better answer.
Note: I encountered most of the exact questions that I had researched and collected. I am sharing a Google Doc link where I noted these questions with two youtube video link inside this.
Google Doc link: https://lnkd.in/gJtmF7YP
Note: I really liked this “STAR’ technique and we can use in other companies as well to answer behavioral questions.
Before my Amazon interview, I used to be very scared of behavioral questions. However, after the interview, I am no longer afraid of them and feel much more confident.
Keep coding, Keep applying!!
